senses.gloss:
कुज् कुज्, cl. 1. P. कोजति, कोजितुम्, to steal;
cl. 6. P. कुजति, to be crooked; [cf. कुञ्ज्.]

कूज् कूज्, cl. 1. P. कूजति, चुकूज, कूजितुम्,
to make any inarticulate or monotonous
sound, to utter a cry as a bird, to coo as a pigeon,
to caw as a crow, to warble; to moan, groan, &c.;
[]
to utter any sound in a low and indistinct voice;
to fill with sounds &c.: Caus. कूजयति: Desid.
चुकूजिषति: Intens. चोकूज्यते, चोकूक्ति.

कुज कु-ज, अस्, m. (fr. 2. कु and rt. जन्), a
tree; the son of the earth, a N. of the planet Mars;
N. of a Daitya, also called Naraka, conquered by
Kṛṣṇa; (आ), f. the daughter of the earth, an epithet
of the goddess Durgā; also of Sītā.
—कुज-पञ्-
चमी, f. the fifth day of the moon occurring on a
Tuesday or the day of Mars, by some thought unlucky.

कूज, अस्, m. rumbling (as of the bowels &c.);
cooing, murmuring, a warbling &c.

कुजन कु-जन, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a bad or
wicked man, a low, mean or vulgar person.

कुजननी कु-जननी, f. (see 1. कु), a bad
mother.

कुजन्मन् कु-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ (see 1. कु),
low-born, of inferior origin.

कुजम्भ कु-जम्भ, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), N. of
a Daitya, a younger brother of Jambha and son of
Prahrāda or Prahlāda, a son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu.

कुजम्भल कुजम्भल, अस्, m. a thief who
breaks into a house; also कुजम्भिर and कुजम्-
भिल; [cf. कुम्भिल.]

कुज्जिश कुज्जिश or कुज्झिश, अस्, m. a sort
of fish; [cf. कुडिश.]

कुज्झटि कुज्झटि, इस् or ई, or कुज्झटिका, f. a
fog or mist.
कूजक, अस्, इका, अम्, cooing, warbling, sounding, &c.
कूजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, cooing, warbling, &c.

कूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, uttered inarticulately, cooed, &c.;
(अम्), n. the cry of a bird, cooing, warbling, &c.

कूजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, making a rumbling sound in the
bowels; warbling.
